description: End a running Live Activity with a final frame. Always end what you start. This cannot be undone: an ended activity cannot be resumed, only replaced by starting a new one, which the user sees as the old one dismissing and a new one animating in.

dismissalDate.description: Keeps the final frame on the Lock Screen until this time, within Apple's four-hour window. Omitted, the activity is dismissed immediately.

externalActivityId.description: The id you started the activity with.

categories.description: Rich categories aligned with points. Use category signal for meanings that vary per bar, such as favorable off-peak and unfavorable peak periods. The server derives labels.

id.description: Stable category id for the time period or bucket.

label.description: Short display label. The server derives the legacy labels array from categories.

signal.description: Contextual interpretation of this category, such as a favorable off-peak or unfavorable peak period.

labels.description: Optional category labels aligned with points. Small surfaces omit them; large widgets and detail views show a readable subset.

max.description: Pins the top of the plot.

min.description: Pins the bottom of the plot. Without a range the plot scales to the series, so a flat-but-noisy one looks dramatic. Send at least `min: 0` whenever the absolute scale is the point.

points.description: 2-60 values, oldest first, plotted evenly spaced. There are no timestamps: send a fixed rolling window. The small surfaces — Lock Screen, small widget, grid cells — average a long series down to what they can draw, so the window you send is always the window shown; send the resolution the data actually has.

rangeValueLabel.description: Short meaning shared by every supplied ranges[].value marker, such as Daily average, Median, or Current. Omit it rather than guessing.

ranges.description: Two to sixty low/high intervals. The server derives legacy points from each value, or from its midpoint when value is absent.

high.description: Top of the observed or expected interval.

low.description: Bottom of the observed or expected interval.

value.description: Optional representative value marked inside the interval. Its meaning is supplied by the chart's rangeValueLabel; clients never infer one.

reference.description: A target, budget, SLO or threshold, drawn as a dashed rule across the plot. Usually the difference between a trend you can read and one you can act on, because above-or-below needs no axis labels. The rule has no numeric label; when its exact value matters, lead the card's short `subtitle` with its formatted meaning and value.

referenceMetadata.description: Optional label and semantic meaning for the numeric reference. Kept separate so older clients still receive and draw the legacy reference number.

label.description: Short name for the rule, such as Target, Baseline, Budget, or Capacity.

semantic.description: Meaning of the rule. Renderers choose its color, dash, emphasis, and accessibility wording.

flow.description: Whether a quantity flows into or out of the measured system.

role.description: What the series represents; affects emphasis and fill treatment, never a producer-selected color.

signal.description: Contextual interpretation from the producer's perspective, not an intrinsic property of the value.

semantic.description: Meaning shared by a single points or range series and inherited by any multi-series entry that omits a semantic dimension.

flow.description: Whether a quantity flows into or out of the measured system.

role.description: What the series represents; affects emphasis and fill treatment, never a producer-selected color.

signal.description: Contextual interpretation from the producer's perspective, not an intrinsic property of the value.

series.description: One to four semantic series for vertical bars, stacked or grouped when multiple. The server derives legacy points as their totals for older clients.

id.description: Stable series id, used to keep renderer-owned presentation consistent.

points.description: Non-negative values aligned one-for-one with every other series, label, and category.

semantic.description: Optional role, flow, and contextual signal hints. Renderers choose all actual colors and patterns.

flow.description: Whether a quantity flows into or out of the measured system.

role.description: What the series represents; affects emphasis and fill treatment, never a producer-selected color.

signal.description: Contextual interpretation from the producer's perspective, not an intrinsic property of the value.

stacking.description: How multiple bar series share each category: stacked into one column or grouped side by side.

style.description: `line` is a sparkline with a soft area fill; `bar` grows every bar from the bottom of the range; `delta` anchors at zero instead, so signed values grow up or down from a zero rule; `range` draws floating low/high intervals with optional publisher-defined value markers.

finalChart.description: The final plot window. Omitted keeps the current chart, which is usually worth keeping — the history is still true once the work is done; `null` removes it.

finalEndsAt.description: Send `null` to remove the countdown: a finished activity otherwise keeps it, and the Lock Screen timer counts up past zero until the frame is dismissed. It does not control dismissal — `dismissalDate` does.

icon.description: SF Symbol name for this row.

id.description: Stable id for this row, unique within the activity.

semantic.description: Optional role and flow hints for this row. `status` remains its health/lifecycle meaning.

flow.description: Whether this item flows into or out of the measured system.

role.description: What this item represents. Renderers choose the emphasis; producers never choose a color.

status.description: Rows with `finished` or `offline` are hidden, and the activity counts the rest as its active total.

statusIcon.description: A second SF Symbol for what this row is doing right now, drawn beside its own icon — arrow.up while charging, pause.fill while held.

subtitle.description: A second line under the row's title.

value.description: The row's reading, as a display string.

finalItems.description: The complete final row list. Omitted keeps the current rows; `[]` or `null` removes them.

finalProgress.description: Progress on the final frame: `1` for a run that completed, `null` to remove the bar. Omitted keeps the current progress, which is right for a run cancelled part-way.

finalSignal.description: Contextual signal for the final frame. Omitted keeps the current signal; `null` clears it.

finalState.description: The last state text. Defaults to "finished".

finalStatusIcon.description: Runtime glyph on the final frame. `null` removes it, which is what an activity that has stopped doing the thing should send.

finalSubtitle.description: What happened, on the last frame — "passed in 4m 12s". There is no `finalTitle`, because the title is frozen, so say it here.

finalUnit.description: Unit after `finalValue`. Omitted keeps the current unit; `null` removes it.

finalValue.description: Headline on the final frame — "3/3". Omitted keeps the current value; `null` removes it.

reason.description: APNs failure reason, when it failed.
